SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. I. S. REGISTRY File No.）
No. D 4860
Section 2, S. B., Shanghai
Duty 27/5/33
Date May 24, 1933.

Subject (in full) Philip Zetterlund, Swedish subject.

Made by D.S.I. Everest Forwarded by [签名] D.I.

With reference to the attached memo dated May 10, 1933,
from the Officer i/c Special Branch regarding Mr. P. Zetterlund,
I have to report the following:-
Philip Zetterlund, Swedish subject, age about 55, has
been a resident of Shanghai for the past 25 years. A
photographer by profession he was employed with the Rembrandt
Photo Co., 3 North Soochow Road, for 15 years prior to the
closing down of this company in 1925. Zetterlund has no
private means and is more or less supported by Mrs. A. Elliot,
who was the owner of the now defunct Rembrandt Photo Co., with
whom he resides at 122 Range Road. During the past year
he has been offering for sale albums of photographs taken
during the local Sino-Japanese hostilities of 1932. In this
capacity he frequently visits local business offices, military
camps etc. Nothing is known against him by this office
either politically or otherwise with the exception that he is
a habitual drunkard.

[签名]
D. S. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
报告

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 C. I. S. 登记处 档案号）
编号 D 4860
上海，特别分部第 2 科
值班日期 1933年5月27日
日期 1933年5月24日。

主题（全称）菲利普·泽特伦德（Philip Zetterlund），瑞典籍。

由特别调查员埃弗勒斯特（Everest）呈报，经 [签名] 督察转呈。

关于附上的1933年5月10日特别分部主管警官有关 P. 泽特伦德先生的备忘录，本人谨报告如下：
菲利普·泽特伦德，瑞典籍，年龄约55岁，已在上海居住过去25年。职业为摄影师，在1925年该公司关闭之前，他受雇于北苏州路3号的伦勃朗照相馆（Rembrandt Photo Co.）达15年之久。泽特伦德无私人财产，或多或少依靠 A. 埃利奥特（A. Elliot）女士供养，后者是现已停业的伦勃朗照相馆的所有人，他与她同住于兰路（Range Road）122号。在过去一年中，他一直兜售在1932年当地中日冲突期间拍摄的照片相册。为此，他经常走访当地的商业机构、军营等。除其有习惯性酗酒恶习外，本处室在政治或其他方面均未掌握对其不利的情况。

[签名]
特别调查员

特别分部主管警官。
